list.title: Projects
list.description: Track the consulting project portfolio and move forward with informed decisions.

empty.title: No projects
empty.description: Create the first project here, or ask the agent in chat.

noResults.title: No matching projects
noResults.description: No project matches the current search and filters.

milestones.emptyDescription: Milestones say what closes each stage of the engagement. Add them from "Edit project", or ask for them in chat.
milestones.error: Could not update the milestone. Try again.

sources.emptyDescription: Documents, interviews, recordings and exports the reconstruction rests on. The agent records them as you hand them over, or you do from the project chat.
sources.noResults: No source matches the search and filters
sources.reference: DeliR keeps the reference to the source and what was extracted from it, not the original file.

panel.selectPrompt: Select a project to see its details.

objective.empty: No objective recorded. While it stays empty, the project chat knows the container but not the mandate.

state.loadError: Could not load projects. Check that the backend is running.

form.description: The same fields the agent writes, on the same record.

hint.objective: Why the engagement exists and what closes it. This is the brief the project chat reads as its mandate.
hint.phase: Where the engagement sits in its lifecycle.
hint.nextStep: The next concrete action, not the end goal.
hint.clientsUnavailable: Client list unavailable: check that the backend is running.
hint.lead: Who runs this engagement. Leave empty when it is not decided yet.
hint.datesOutOfOrder: The end precedes the start: check the dates.

placeholder.objective: E.g. rebuild the AS-IS order-to-cash process, validate it with stakeholders, simulate it and measure lead-time KPIs.
placeholder.nextStep: E.g. schedule interviews with the order desk

error.clientRequired: Select the client this project belongs to.

phase.Discovery: Scope, stakeholders and sources: what the engagement covers.
phase.AS-IS: Rebuilding the existing process from sources and interviews.
phase.Validazione: The AS-IS is confirmed by the stakeholders who run it.
phase.TO-BE: Designing the target process and its alternatives.
phase.Simulazione: The model runs: KPIs, scenarios and impacts are measured.
phase.Delivery: Handing over results and recommendations, closing the engagement.

status.In corso: Active work, moving along the plan.
status.A rischio: Active, but blocked on time, scope or client availability.
status.In pausa: Paused by the client or the team, not abandoned.
status.Completato: Deliverables handed over and engagement closed.

processStage.Discovery: Process scope: who runs it, where it starts and ends.
processStage.AS-IS: The process as it runs today, rebuilt from the evidence.
processStage.TO-BE: The process as it is meant to become.
processStage.Validazione: The model is being confirmed by the people who run the process.

processStatus.Bozza: Recorded: it has a name, not yet the content.
processStatus.In corso: Active reconstruction: interviews, evidence, a model taking shape.
processStatus.Da validare: Complete enough to take to the stakeholders.
processStatus.Validato: Confirmed by the people who run it: safe to build on.

empty.description: Register the processes in scope: the record starts here, the model is built on the canvas.

hint.stage: Which process you are describing: today's, or the one you want.
hint.status: How far that description has got.
hint.owner: The team or person who runs the process. Do not guess.
hint.readiness: How complete the process knowledge is, not how good the process is.

form.createDescription: Creates the process record and its empty BPMN model. It draws nothing.
form.editDescription: Edits the record. The BPMN model content is left untouched.
